method: legacy Actionability-Gap-Gated Recovery field union retained for advanced compatibility
v1_profile_policy: The 165 source fields remain frozen for provenance. Requiredness statements for action and recovery apply only to dismissal_recovery_advanced; v1 protocol fields are separately counted in item.schema.json/message_judgment.

requiredness_legend.required: Every advanced recovery episode must carry the field; v1 message items use explicit null/not_applicable where the union container remains required.
requiredness_legend.required_if: Required when the condition written after the colon is true.
requiredness_legend.required_if_observable: Required only after the target-device capability probe establishes observability.
requiredness_legend.recommended: Not needed to parse the record, but needed for the planned analysis or reproducibility.

global_missing_value_policy.rule: Never use an unqualified null or empty string.
global_missing_value_policy.ios_boundary: iOS/XCUI and VoiceOver capabilities are candidates until verified on the target device and OS. XCTest/Appium page-source visibility must not be treated as VoiceOver focus, utterance, or deployable accessibility visibility.
